results.title: Ente Bhoomi - Digital Land Records System for Kerala
results.note: Kerala survey portal describes digitally surveyed parcel maps; exact Kozhikode coverage and anonymous vector access unverified.

results.title: Bhu-Naksha Kerala
results.note: Government cadastral mapping interface supports re-surveyed sketches and survey/subdivision selection; no direct feature service established.

results.title: Revenue eServices: e-maps
results.note: Department describes cadastral mapping and public updated parcel sketches, but does not prove open vector export.

assessment: Official Kerala portals expose cadastral map and land-record services. Kozhikode coverage and machine-readable anonymous access remain unverified.
